ugly.en: And so what could have been a really nice exchange ended up becoming pretty ugly.
ugly.zh: 所以，本可以是一次非常美好的交流，最终却变得相当难看。

ugly.en: A goblin, if you don’t know this word, is a sort of imaginary, naughty, often ugly creature that plays tricks on humans.
ugly.zh: 如果你不知道 goblin 这个词是什么意思，它指的是一种虚构的、调皮捣蛋、通常长得丑陋、喜欢捉弄人类的生物。

ugly.en: Yeah, great idea! Now, whether you have one or not, our history and culture is full of sisters, from the fairy tale of Cinderella and her ugly sisters to tennis players, Venus and Serena Williams.
ugly.zh: 太棒了！无论你有没有姐妹，我们的历史和文化中到处都是姐妹的身影，从灰姑娘和她丑陋的姐姐们的童话故事，到网球运动员维纳斯和小威廉姆斯。

ugly.en: Nuclear power stations would have no ugly black smoke coming out of the top, there would be no dusty coal trucks driving in and out of the plant every day, there would just be harmless water vapour coming out of a large chimney.
ugly.zh: 核电站顶部不会冒出难看的黑烟，没有满载灰尘的运煤卡车每天进出电厂，高大的烟囱里只会冒出无害的水蒸气。
